messages:
ben: Vendor asked if Redwood can support a single launch window covering H100/H200, MI300 and Gaudi. Their ask: unified press day. Reality: Gaudi certs look late. Can partnerships + comms advise on optics and marketplace gating?
vendor-pm: Quick context: H100/H200/MI300 image manifests done; Gaudi driver QA still in validation (possible 48-72h slip). Full brief at https://vendor.example.com/partner-note.
olivia: If Gaudi might slip, prefer single internal embargo but phased public visibility. That lets partners prep without promising GA.
marta: Operational ops: we'll need two marketplace states — LAUNCH_VISIBLE and PREVIEW_ONLY — and a clear SKU tag mapping for each. I'll draft the tag matrix.
chris: From infra: implement runtime fallback routing so requests for gaudi auto-route to mi300-quant or h200-quant when gaudi pool is empty. I can put a test harness together.
comm-team: For external copy, avoid dates. Suggested line: "Available in select regions at launch; additional SKUs to follow." Keeps PR flexible.
sec-ops: Note for security/compliance: any EAP/preview SKUs must be isolated with stricter audit logging. SI customers on Gaudi EAP should sign an addendum.
ben: Good point. Partnerships prefers unified internal handshake so partner teams get the full brief; external messaging can be phased.
vendor-pm: We'll try to accelerate Gaudi QA but will update manifest immediately if it slips. We'll include recommended fallbacks in the manifest.
olm: (typo)
marta: Example fallback manifest snippet (internal):
```
fallbacks: gaudi -> [mi300-quant, h200-quant]
fallbacks: h200  -> [h100-quant]
```
chris: I'll implement routing JSON like that and run a small canary suite: chat + summarization + embeddings, 50 prompts each on quant variants. ETA 36h after tags.
comm-team: Proposed cadence: Day 0 announcement (high level), Day 3 technical blog + SKU availability update. If Gaudi delayed, we mark it as "preview" and open EAP. Legal okayed soft language.
ben: Action items: marta publish tag matrix + marketplace states; chris build fallback routing & canary; vendor-pm finalize tags or update risk by Wed COB; sec-ops draft EAP isolation checklist; comm-team prep staged messaging. Reconvene Wed AM for go/no-go.
vendor-pm: Noted. If Gaudi slips >48h we'll recommend marketplace mark as PREVIEW only.
marta: I'll push the tag mapping to /docs/partners/tags and ping infra.
chris: Canary infra ticket created CL-9001, pending tags.
sec-ops: EAP checklist draft in /docs/security/eap-gaudi.md.
comm-team: Drafts up in /docs/partners/announce-drafts; looping in PR and legal.
ben: Thanks all. Keep updates here so we can maintain the embargo handshake. :thumbsup:
